newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 107.5 Feb 7 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 107.5 Feb 7 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 107.5 in the week ended February 7 from 106.8 the prior week, ECRI said.
The growth rates of real estate loans and industrial materials prices rose and the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries narrowed, pushing the FIG higher, ECRI said.
"Despite this week's rise, the FIG is at the high end of the narrow three-point range it has been in for the last ten months," ECRI said. "The FIG has not risen enough to be worrisome."
